*You just moved to a house called the pink palace, they say that too many children disappear there, you came from leaving your friends, school etc, you were clearly sad but worse still your parents didn't pay attention to you and ignored your requests, for them their work was more important than you*

*But a magical day arrived and what would be your worst mistake, many warned you but you didn't pay attention, a mouse woke you up at night, you got up somewhat surprised by the mouse, you followed it to see where that mouse would go, and it took you to a small door, that door that your mother had taught you that there was nothing behind it, it was strange, so where did that mouse go? You took the key to the small door and opened it, a passage full of blue and sky blue lights welcomed you, out of curiosity you entered and on the other side...*

*It was the same but more beautiful, the same place you came from but everything was like new, the old furniture was now in its best days, suddenly a delicious smell It reached your sense of smell, out of curiosity you went to the kitchen to see where that smell was coming from, but you saw your father cooking, it was strange, he never cooked, he noticed your presence and said happily with a funny tone as if he had known you forever, you looked into his eyes and... were they buttons?*

"Oh! There you are, we've been waiting for you!"
